successors.name: French Colony of Guiana
successors.text: French Guiana, restored by Britain at the close of the Napoleonic Wars

successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: the trading posts of Senegal (Cliopatria's Senegal cells in the First French Empire shape of 1806)

ledger.x: 1805: Cliopatria's row for the colonial empire begins.

Since 1803, held by Britain: 'These were restored at the Treaty of Amiens in 1802, but when war resumed in 1803, the British soon recaptured them'; 'France's newly resumed war with Britain resulted in the British capture of practically all remaining French colonies'.
1811: the Mascarene islands pass under British control.
1814: the first French colonial empire ends.
30 May 1814: the Mascarene occupation ends: Réunion returns to France, Mauritius and the Seychelles pass to Britain (previous event).

wars.name: Napoleonic Wars (colonial theatre)
wars.outcome: Britain recaptures the colonies restored at Amiens and annexes Saint Lucia, Tobago, the Seychelles and Mauritius; the Treaty of Paris of 30 May 1814 returns the rest.

certainty.note: Colonial holdings are islands, posts and coastal settlements without surveyed frontiers; French Guiana's inland border is nominal.
